suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Document the circular-import-break pattern used in runtime.py: when two modules in the same package have mutual runtime dependencies, move imports inside the method bodies that need them (local imports) rather than at module top-level. This pattern was necessary to break the runtime.py ↔ filesystem.py cycle after consolidation.
